title: Use indexed, stable ordering for insight lists without an explicit order
answers: Why is listing insights without an order parameter slow?
What is the default order of the insights API?
How should insight list pagination handle identical modification timestamps?
body:
Symptom: API clients listing insights without an order parameter wait tens of seconds per page, occupying a web worker throughout each request.
Root cause: products/product_analytics/backend/presentation/insight.py:InsightViewSet.order_queryset previously sorted on the vestigial, nullable, unindexed Insight.order column, forcing repeated project-wide scans and sorts during offset pagination.
Fix pattern: Default to descending last_modified_at, covered by dashboarditem_team_lmod_idx, and descending pk to break timestamp ties deterministically; populated legacy order values must not control this default.
Constraints: Apply this default only when both order and search are absent. Search requests retain their existing queryset ordering, and explicit order parameters retain their own handling. Production index-seek performance was inferred from the index definition, not verified with EXPLAIN.
applies: Insight API list default ordering and pagination in InsightViewSet.order_queryset.
